title: FIH starting dose (MRSD) from a rat NOAEL
context: You are projecting a first-in-human starting dose using the FDA 2005 guidance approach. The most relevant species is the rat, with a NOAEL of 50 mg/kg. Use the standard body-surface-area (km) conversion (rat km = 6, human km = 37) to get the human-equivalent dose (HED), then apply the default safety factor of 10 to obtain the Maximum Recommended Starting Dose (MRSD).
decision_required: Compute the MRSD in mg/kg. Show HED then MRSD. Finish with a line: answer: <MRSD in mg/kg>.
source: FDA 2005 Guidance for Industry — Estimating the Maximum Safe Starting Dose (km factors, safety factor 10). Deterministic formula — objective ground truth.

title: Human clearance by allometric scaling
context: A candidate has a measured plasma clearance of 30 mL/min/kg in the rat (body weight 0.25 kg). Project the TOTAL human clearance (60 kg human) using simple single-species allometric scaling with the standard exponent of 0.75 (clearance scales with body weight^0.75).
decision_required: Compute the projected total human clearance in mL/min. Finish with a line: answer: <human CL in mL/min>.
source: Simple allometric scaling (exponent 0.75). Deterministic — objective. Note: real human CL can deviate from single-species allometry; this grades correct METHOD application.
